venues.notes_summary: **DC — Monday 3/9.** Slow start; around 8:30 MOD cut the host and server (MOD and a bartender covered). Around 9:15 walk-ins and industry friends filled the room; last call pushed back 30 minutes to drive revenue; building cleared by 12:30. Exceeded the daily target. Kitchen: 12.18% of sales; the $2 oyster special continues to be a hit (13 orders, par likely 100-150); mignonette reduced to 1/2 tsp. MOD: Josh.

venues.name: D&C EV
venues.notes_summary: **EV — Monday 3/9.** First turn was tough: only 27 covers before 8pm due to sunny weather; fielded esoteric beverage queries and received job offers and a surprise cheek smooch. Then got busy with dates, friend groups, post-dinners and coworkers; business conferences brought large parties (31% of guests in large parties). Lots of eau de vie neat pours; James handled big party sizes. 6 large parties, 6 solos. Comps $89.62. Top sellers: Masari, First Time Listener, Year of the Trees. Door: well-paced start in nice weather, many UK guests; bar full 8:30, room by 9; little list accommodated, including an investor group of 5; busy until ~10, then slowed; a 10 top ~10:30 fit across T2-T5. No-shows: Kenan Anderson 2 @ 8pm; Olga Iodko 6 @ 8:30pm (charge unsuccessful). (Form typed '3//10'; actual service date 3/9.)
